_: living-adventurers SPIKE — proves the abstract-ghost-sim + materialize-on-co-location loop (idea #23). ONE named adventurer (Kjeld the Wanderer) lives an off-stage adventuring life: a controller quest (MFLA_Ctrl, startGameEnabled) runs MFAdvController, which (1) every SimIntervalHours in-game hours increments MFLA_DeedCount while Kjeld is OFF-STAGE at MFLA_HoldMarker (no actor processed) — standing in for 'cleared another dungeon', and (2) polls real-time presence and MoveTo's the SINGLE persistent Kjeld ref (MFLA_KjeldRef) into the Sleeping Giant Inn when the player is there, back to the holding marker when they leave. Bjorn the bard offers a Rumors topic gated on MFLA_DeedCount>=1 ('傳唱'): the tavern talks about Kjeld's off-stage deeds. THREE proofs: deed counter advances off-screen / Kjeld appears+vanishes with the player / rumor reflects the count. NEXT (not in this spike): real missive tasks need roadmap #7-9; cast sourced from real standalone-follower mods; player can poach/hire/fund. TEST: new game or save+reload, `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn` → Kjeld materializes; leave (coc Riverwood) + return → he re-materializes; wait a few in-game hours (or `set MFLA_DeedCount to 3`) → talk to Bjorn → rumor line appears. `getglobalvalue MFLA_DeedCount` shows the off-stage progress.

globals._: abstract-sim deed counter; ticked off-stage by the controller, read by the rumor INFO via GetGlobalValue

classes.name: Wandering Adventurer
classes._: autoCalcStats needs a class or the NPC spawns ~0 HP (memory autocalc-without-class-dead-npc)

npcs.name: Kjeld the Wanderer
npcs.greeting: Just passing through. There's always another contract on the board.

npcs.name: Bjorn Song-Thread
npcs.greeting: Pull up a chair, friend. I've a tale or two.

placements._: Kjeld's persistent ref. Placed off-stage at the holding marker spot (Tamriel, buried) — the controller teleports him in/out. editorId MFLA_KjeldRef so the controller's Adventurer property (objectEditorId) and any forced: alias can bind the PLACED ACHR (forcing the NPC_ base silently fails — memory radiant_package_spec note).
Off-stage holding marker (same buried Tamriel spot). Kjeld sits here, frozen and unprocessed, while the player is elsewhere — this is the 'abstract' state made concrete.
On-stage materialize point inside the Sleeping Giant Inn (RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn 0x0133C6). MoveTo snaps Kjeld to the inn navmesh here when the player arrives.
Bjorn the bard lives in the inn full-time — he does the 傳唱.

quests._: Controller host + dialogue host. startGameEnabled so MFAdvController.OnInit arms both the game-time sim tick and the real-time presence poll the moment the save loads. type=None: pure background controller, no journal.
quests.name: Living Adventurers (spike)

scripts._: Bind MFAdvController to the host quest. Adventurer/InnMarker/HoldMarker are object props bound to the PLACED refs by editorId; DeedCount to the GLOB; the two floats tune cadence.

dialogue._: The 傳唱: Bjorn talks about Kjeld's OFF-STAGE deeds, gated on the abstract-sim counter. Only surfaces once MFLA_DeedCount >= 1 — proof the rumor reflects what the ghost-sim did while the player wasn't watching. Real version (#17 pipeline) would template many such lines per deed-type.
responses: Aye — Kjeld the Wanderer's been busy. Cleared another barrow single-handed, they say.
Folk are starting to know his name. There'll be a song in it before long.
